name: Ceramic 70
shortDescription: Huper Optik Ceramic 70 delivers near-clear solar control with 70% VLT, 99% UV block, and signal-safe TiN ceramic construction for Philadelphia offices and rowhomes.
description:
Ceramic 70 sits at the bright end of Huper Optik's flagship Ceramic Series — 70% visible light transmission paired with the patented dual-layer Titanium Nitride (TiN) ceramic coating that earned Huper Optik its US patent. For Philadelphia property owners who want meaningful solar protection without darkening their interiors, Ceramic 70 is the natural starting point.

The TiN ceramic construction is 100% metal-free, which means no interference with Wi-Fi, GPS, cellular signals, or smart-home devices — a practical differentiator for Center City offices, University City research buildings, and Fishtown rowhomes with modern home automation. The film rejects 83% of infrared radiation and blocks 99% of UV rays while maintaining a neutral, low-reflective appearance.

For Philadelphia rowhomes with south or east-facing single-pane glass, Ceramic 70 addresses UV-driven fading and summer heat gain without creating the dimmed, cave-like effect that darker films can produce in narrower row house rooms. Historic district properties with glass restrictions often find Ceramic 70 fits within HOA or preservation guidelines because it reads as nearly clear from the exterior.

Window Film Philadelphia evaluates Ceramic 70 suitability against glass type, orientation, existing coatings, and frame condition. Ceramic 70 carries Huper Optik's lifetime residential warranty and 15-year commercial coverage.

The city's housing stock includes one of the largest concentrations of older single-pane rowhome glass in the Northeast. Therm-X is engineered for this scenario: adding meaningful thermal resistance to existing glass without the cost or disruption of full window replacement.

Airy craftsman homes with original single-pane wood windows, Therm-X 70 helps address the drafts and heat loss that older glass produces in winter while blocking UV fading and some summer heat gain. Therm-X 70 carries Huper Optik's lifetime residential warranty.

description:

It installs on the interior surface of existing glass — storefront panels, door sidelites, school windows, government building facades, and residential entry points — without changing the look of the window. From outside, treated glass looks identical to untreated glass.

For Philadelphia schools, government buildings, museums along the Benjamin Franklin Parkway, and retail storefronts on high-traffic commercial corridors, Clear Shield provides a passive glass retention layer that works continuously without requiring power, maintenance, or behavioral changes from building occupants. When glass breaks — from a storm, an accident, or attempted forced entry — the film holds the fragments in a coherent pattern that slows penetration and reduces laceration risk.

Philadelphia's retail environment has elevated concerns about smash-and-grab incidents, particularly on high-value commercial corridors. Clear Shield film adds meaningful delay to forced entry through storefront glass — the time required to penetrate film-retained glass versus bare glass is a practical deterrent in scenarios where speed of access is the attacker's primary advantage.

Clear Shield can be layered with Huper Optik solar control or decorative films for a combined security and solar specification. Carries a 10-year commercial warranty.

name: Security Shield 35 Neutral 8 Mil
shortDescription: Huper Optik Security Shield 35 Neutral 8 Mil combines 8-mil safety film with 35% VLT solar control — a dual-purpose specification for Philadelphia buildings needing both forced-entry protection and solar management.
description:
Huper Optik Security Shield 35 Neutral 8 Mil is a dual-purpose safety and solar control film — an 8-mil construction that combines glass fragment retention with 35% visible light transmission and meaningful solar heat gain reduction. For Philadelphia buildings that need both security performance and solar management in a single specification, Shield 35 Neutral eliminates the need for layering separate safety and solar films.

The 8-mil construction provides the same glass fragment retention and forced-entry delay as the clear Security 8 Mil, while the tinted construction adds solar control performance. At 35% VLT, the film provides daytime visual privacy and glare reduction alongside its security function. The 99% UV block protects building contents from fading — important for Philadelphia retail environments, museums, and government facilities where both security and content protection are priorities. The neutral tone maintains a professional, non-reflective exterior appearance suitable for a range of building types.

For Philadelphia government buildings, schools, and commercial facilities that need both security and solar control, Shield 35 Neutral provides a single-film solution. The film is well suited for Philadelphia public schools where security requirements and classroom comfort are both priorities — the 35% VLT reduces glare on teaching surfaces while the 8-mil construction addresses glass security. For street-level retail storefronts on high-traffic corridors where smash-and-grab concerns and solar heat gain are both operational issues, the dual-purpose specification addresses both in a single installation. In IECC Climate Zone 4A, the solar control component contributes to summer cooling load reduction.

Security Shield 35 Neutral 8 Mil carries a 10-year commercial warranty. CSI specification documents are available for architectural and engineering submittals on security and government projects.
